rationale: The reviewer found that GC content (40.7% vs 55.1%) alone separates the classes, measured a GC-threshold accuracy of 1.00 that matches the model's 0.99, and proposed GC/k-mer baselines and GC-matched evaluation. They also raised a real issue the key doesn't mention: the 'novel phage discovery where homology tools fail' claim was never benchmarked against homology tools and was tested on a balanced, non-divergent set.
